title: Talking With Teammates
author: Hive
intro: 这一课是工作中和同事交流的常用句：每天的进度汇报、请人帮忙做代码审查、解释一个 bug、提出方案，以及说明自己需要更多时间。朗读时注意礼貌的语气，像在真实的站会和群聊里说话。
tips: Would you mind、Could you 的语气要软，句尾不要上扬成命令。
解释问题时先说结论，再讲原因和细节，句子之间停半拍。
segments: Quick update from me: I finished the login page yesterday, and I'm working on the password reset flow today.
I'm blocked on the API response, so I might need some help from the backend team this afternoon.
Could you review my pull request when you get a chance? It's mostly small changes to the form validation.
Would you mind taking a quick look at the test cases? I want to make sure I didn't miss an edge case.
I think I found the bug. When a user logs in twice, the session token gets overwritten.
It only happens on mobile browsers, and I'm not sure yet why.
Here's what I suggest. We can add a quick check first, and then refactor the storage logic next sprint.
What if we split the work into two parts? I'll handle the database changes, and you can take the UI.
Honestly, I need more time on this one. I'm about two days behind, so could we move the deadline?
Let me know if that works for you, and I'll update the ticket once it's done.
